description: The SELECT WHEN clause of a record description entry (the condition-name condition under which the entry is associated with a record during input and output operations), ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.49 and 2023 13.18.51 - a COBOL-2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): a 1985 record description entry is a data description entry, whose Format 1 offers data-name-1/FILLER, REDEFINES, PICTURE, USAGE, SIGN, OCCURS, SYNCHRONIZED, JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO and VALUE, and no SELECT WHEN clause (§1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2: 'The remaining clauses may be written in any order'); §2002:13.16.49 reads 'The SELECT WHEN clause specifies a condition-name condition under which a record description entry is associated with a record during input and output operations' (§2002:13.16.49.2 SR1: 'A SELECT WHEN clause may be specified only at the 01 level of a record description entry'), and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 120: 'The SELECT WHEN clause of a record description permits selection of one of several record description entries in the file section during input-output operations.' §2014:13.18.51 and §2014:13.18.51.2 SR1 carry it, so 2014 = 2023. kb/Work PB5578.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SWH9CL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F1 ASSIGN TO "swh9cl.dat".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F1 RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 20 CHARACTERS
    FORMAT CHARACTER DATA.
01 R1 SELECT WHEN IS-A.
    05 R1-KEY PIC X.
        88 IS-A VALUE "A".
    05 R1-TXT PIC X(4).
01 R2 SELECT WHEN OTHER.
    05 R2-KEY PIC X.
    05 R2-NUM PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
